evidence.source: Academia Sinica, 漢字構形資料庫
evidence.field: 麼 character page; 字形演變 and Unicode fields
evidence.text: The inspected character page identifies 麼 (U+9EBC) and displays a 小篆 / 說文 form category. The page states the site is All Rights Reserved, so it is useful as linked form evidence but not as a glyph image asset.
evidence.title: 漢字「麼」：字形演變

evidence.field: 說文解字·麼; 康熙字典; 國語辭典; 字源字形
evidence.text: The page quotes the Shuowen statement 細也。从幺麻聲 and labels it 新附. It also quotes the Kangxi entry associating 幺麽 with small/fine and saying 么 is俗作 for 麼, 誤. Its dictionary section cites the small-insect use from 列子·湯問, and a Tang poem containing a question-final 麼; these are cited attestations, not independently inspected manuscript spellings. The page lists Song Huang Tingjian for a suffix-like use. These records attest distinct uses but do not establish a direct semantic development from ‘small/fine’ to particle.
evidence.title: 麼 mó、me、ma、má - 漢典

evidence.source: 国务院; 1956 漢字簡化方案 transcription
evidence.field: 国务院关于公布汉字简化方案的决议; 第一表
evidence.text: The document says first-table forms were to be used from 1 February 1956 and pairs 么（麽）. This establishes 么 as a standardized simplified counterpart of 麽 from that scheme; it does not negate the distinct older lexicographic association of 么 with 幺.
evidence.title: 汉字简化方案

evidence.text: This file is explicitly described as a modern vector drawing of 幺 in Shuowen seal-script style, created with Inkscape. Commons identifies source databases and states that the drawing is public domain, with attribution appreciated but not required. It is a modern reconstruction/redrawing, not an artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:幺-seal.svg

evidence.text: The rights notice explicitly places glyph images and glyph-attribute information obtained through the site's query interface under CC0 1.0. This notice applies to query-interface glyph images and attributes, not other Academia Sinica sites or linked dictionary text.
evidence.title: 版權聲明

evidence.text: The site describes databases for ancient and modern character forms, including oracle-bone, bronze, seal, and clerical transformation data. No character-specific query record for 么 or 麽 was inspected in this pass, so no Xiaoxuetang image is selected.
evidence.title: 小學堂

search_audit.query: 么 幺 古文字 字形 演变 小篆 說文 麽 字源 site:edu.cn OR site:sinica.edu.tw; site:xiaoxuetang.uchicago.edu 么 字形 幺 麽 小學堂; Wikimedia Commons 么 幺 Chinese character oracle bronze glyph file; 么 幺 麽 汉典 康熙 列子 么虫 词源 宋代
search_audit.outcome: Inspected Han Dian, Academia Sinica’s 麼 form page, the Xiaoxuetang site, and attempted Ctext dictionary access (403). Search results supplied a 么虫 quotation, but no primary artifact or early-form series for 么/幺.

search_audit.query: site:xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw "么" 字形演變; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File 幺 seal script character; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File 麽 seal script character; site:unicode.org/cgi-bin/GetUnihanData.pl?codepoint=4E48 kMandarin
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the exact Commons file page for 幺-seal.svg and verified its direct original-image link and public-domain reuse terms. Search results did not establish a character-specific Xiaoxuetang record for 么; the retrieved downloadable seal tables are not selected as image assets.

Search surfaced unrelated bronze-script file pages and the Xiaoxuetang Shuowen seal table but no verified bronze image for 幺. Direct open of the candidate 幺-bronze.svg page failed with cache miss; it is not used.

gaps: No inspected primary paleographic source established the earliest attested graph or graphic evolution of 么 or 幺. The Shuowen quotation supports a transmitted analysis of 麼, not the earliest forms of 么.

The Shuowen quotation identifies 麻 as the sound element in 麼, but this pass did not verify matched historical readings for 麻 and 麼 or current official Unihan readings. No component sound-array claim is made.

The dossier and lexicographic page support treating 么 as associated with 幺 in one usage and as the 1956 simplified counterpart of 麽 in another; the precise chronology and graphic mechanism of the 幺 variant relationship remain unverified.

A small/fine sense is cited in 列子·湯問, while question-final and suffix uses are cited separately, including later literary examples. Their semantic bridge and earliest manuscript spellings remain unresolved; composition dates alone cannot date surviving orthographic forms.

The dossier’s competing word histories involving 何物/物 and 無 concern the spoken interrogative word and its spellings, not the construction of 麼 or the shape history of 么. This pass did not resolve their scholarly disagreement.
No local Baxter–Sagart TSV or Unihan exact-row data was inspected in this run; current reading values should not be inferred from secondary transcriptions.
Xiaoxuetang was not queried for a specific candidate record in this pass. No Xiaoxuetang glyph is proposed; its rights notice was inspected and its limited scope recorded.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition (Eastern Han dictionary form; modern vector redraw)
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 幺 in the Shuowen seal-script style; the cited dictionary tradition analyzes 麼 as 幺 plus phonetic 麻.
items.alt: Black seal-style strokes representing 幺 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: Shows the 幺 form named as the semantic element in the transmitted Shuowen analysis of 麼, while its status as a modern reconstruction is explicit.
items.rights: Public domain dedication for the modern vector representation; attribution appreciated but not required.

limitations.text: This selected image is a modern vector reconstruction in a historical script style, not a photograph or facsimile of an excavated artifact. The inspected sources do not establish an early attested form of 么/幺 or a complete graphic sequence.
